name: 2026 Florida Managed Areas
description:
The Florida Natural Areas Inventory is the primary source for information on Florida's conservation lands. FNAI's database includes boundaries and statistics for more than 2,900 federal, state, local, and private managed areas, all provided directly by the managing agencies. National parks, state forests, wildlife management areas, local and private preserves are examples of the managed areas included. The shapefile is called FLMA for Florida Managed Areas; updated versions are published quarterly.

FLORIDA CONSERVATION LANDS (layer name FLMA): This is a polygon data layer for public (and some private) lands that the Florida Natural Areas Inventory (FNAI) has identified as having natural resource value and that are being managed at least partially for conservation purposes. The term "Managed Area" refers to a managed conservation land.

variableMeasured.name: ma_id
variableMeasured.description: Managed Area ID, designed by NatureServe. Unique identifier for each Managed Area.

variableMeasured.name: maname
variableMeasured.description: Official name of the Managed Area (conservation land)

variableMeasured.name: majorma
variableMeasured.description: Official name of the Major Managed Area.  Major Managed Area refers to a larger Managed Area that contains the Managed Area in question.

variableMeasured.name: matype
variableMeasured.description: Code for the Managed Area by lead managing agency. Each Managed Area has been coded as 1st byte = Managing Agency Category: F=Federal, S=State, L=Local, P=Private, 2nd and 3rd bytes = Managing Agency: (e.g., AF= US Air Force), 4th and 5th bytes = Managed Area Unit Type (e.g., AB= Air Force Base)

variableMeasured.name: managing_a
variableMeasured.description: Name of the lead managing agency for the Managed Area.

variableMeasured.name: matype2
variableMeasured.description: Code for Managed Area by managing agency category.

variableMeasured.name: owner

variableMeasured.name: coowners
variableMeasured.description: Name(s) of additional owner(s) of the managed area

variableMeasured.name: ownertypes
variableMeasured.description: Owner Types

variableMeasured.name: totacres
variableMeasured.description: Total number of acres within the Managed Area

variableMeasured.name: ltf_acres
variableMeasured.description: Number of acres within the Managed Area that are in less-than-fee ownership.
